current_program:
mpmath_project_root="$PWD"
git config --global --add safe.directory "$mpmath_project_root"
python -m venv .venv
. "$mpmath_project_root/.venv/bin/activate"
python -m pip install --retries 10 --timeout 60 --upgrade pip setuptools
python -m pip install --retries 10 --timeout 60 --upgrade '.[develop,gmpy,docs,ci]' numpy matplotlib
cd "$mpmath_project_root"
